actor_awards.notes: One of France's most celebrated international stars, she was the first French person to win an Academy Award (for Best Actress in 'Room at the Top', 1959). She was known for her intense, intelligent performances and her marriage to Yves Montand.

filmography.title: Room at the Top
filmography.role_description: An unhappy, older, married French woman who has a tragic affair with an ambitious young clerk.
filmography.plot: An ambitious young man from a poor background attempts to claw his way to the top of society in a Northern English town, but his love for an older married woman complicates his plans.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Win – Best Actress; BAFTA: Win – Best Foreign Actress; Cannes Film Festival: Win – Best Actress

filmography.title: Les Diaboliques (Diabolique)
filmography.role_description: The cold, calculating mistress of a cruel headmaster who teams up with his frail wife to murder him.
filmography.plot: The cruel headmaster of a boys' boarding school is murdered by his wife and his mistress, but the body disappears, leading to a terrifying mystery.

filmography.title: Ship of Fools
filmography.role_description: A political agitator and drug addict being deported from Cuba who has a poignant romance with the ship's doctor.
filmography.plot: A diverse group of passengers on an ocean liner bound for Germany in 1933 grapple with their personal problems and the rising tide of fascism.
filmography.awards: Oscar: Nomination – Best Actress; BAFTA: Nomination – Best Foreign Actress

filmography.title: Army of Shadows (L'Armée des ombres)
filmography.role_description: A brilliant and courageous leader in the French Resistance who eventually faces a heartbreaking moral dilemma.
filmography.plot: An account of underground resistance fighters in Nazi-occupied France during World War II, detailing their intense paranoia and necessary sacrifices.

filmography.title: Casque d'Or
filmography.role_description: A beautiful, golden-haired prostitute in Belle Époque Paris whose love for an honest carpenter leads to a fatal gang war.
filmography.plot: A tragic romance blossoms between a Parisian streetwalker and a carpenter, inciting the jealousy and wrath of the local criminal underworld.

filmography.title: The Crucible (Les Sorcières de Salem)
filmography.role_description: The principled, forgiving wife of John Proctor, caught in the hysteria of the Salem witch trials. Signoret starred opposite her husband, Yves Montand.
filmography.plot: An adaptation of Arthur Miller's play about the Salem witch trials, where a young woman's lies lead to mass hysteria and tragic consequences.

filmography.title: The Widow Couderc (La Veuve Couderc)
filmography.role_description: A hardworking widow in a rural French village who takes in an escaped convict (Alain Delon), leading to a passionate but doomed affair.
filmography.plot: An escaped criminal finds refuge and work at the farm of a tough, older widow, sparking a romance that upsets the local community.

filmography.title: The Cat (Le Chat)
filmography.role_description: An aging former trapeze artist locked in a bitter, silent war of attrition with her estranged husband (Jean Gabin).
filmography.plot: An elderly couple living in a soon-to-be-demolished Parisian suburb communicate only through written notes and mutual hatred, focusing their malice on a stray cat.
filmography.awards: Berlin International Film Festival: Win – Silver Bear for Best Actress

filmography.title: Madame Rosa (La Vie devant soi)
filmography.role_description: An aging, former prostitute and Auschwitz survivor who cares for the children of other prostitutes in Paris.
filmography.plot: An elderly Jewish woman and former prostitute forms a deep bond with an Arab orphan boy she is raising in her cramped Parisian apartment.
filmography.awards: César Award: Win – Best Actress; Oscar: Win – Best Foreign Language Film (Film)

filmography.title: La Ronde
filmography.role_description: The prostitute who begins and ends the chain of romantic encounters in Max Ophüls' classic film.
filmography.plot: A series of interconnected stories exploring the cynical and cyclical nature of love and sex in 19th-century Vienna.
filmography.awards: BAFTA: Win – Best Film from any Source (Film)

filmography.title: The Deadly Affair
filmography.role_description: The Jewish survivor and widow of a civil servant suspected of treason, investigated by a British spy.
filmography.plot: A British intelligence officer investigates the apparent suicide of a Foreign Office official, uncovering a complex spy ring.

filmography.title: Games
filmography.role_description: A mysterious cosmetics saleswoman who manipulates a bored, wealthy couple into a deadly game.
filmography.plot: A wealthy couple invites a mysterious older woman to live with them, but she introduces them to a series of psychological games that turn deadly.

filmography.title: The Confession (L'Aveu)
filmography.role_description: The wife of a Czech minister (Yves Montand) who is targeted during a Stalinist purge.
filmography.plot: Based on a true story, a loyal Communist official in Czechoslovakia is arrested and subjected to psychological torture to extract a false confession.

filmography.title: Term of Trial
filmography.role_description: The cynical, frustrated wife of a devoted but unappreciated schoolteacher (Laurence Olivier).
filmography.plot: A dedicated teacher in a tough school faces ruin when a vindictive student accuses him of sexual assault after he rejects her advances.

filmography.title: Is Paris Burning?
filmography.role_description: A small but memorable role as a Parisian cafe patron during the liberation.
filmography.plot: The story of the liberation of Paris in August 1944 and the struggles of the various resistance factions.

filmography.title: The Seagull
filmography.role_description: A vain, aging actress in this adaptation of Anton Chekhov's play, directed by Sidney Lumet.
filmography.plot: A group of friends and relatives gather at a Russian country estate, leading to a web of unrequited love and artistic frustrations.

filmography.title: Police Python 357
filmography.role_description: The wealthy, disabled wife of a corrupt police commissioner (François Périer).
filmography.plot: A dedicated police inspector investigates the murder of his mistress, only to find the evidence pointing back to himself and his corrupt superior.

filmography.title: Dédée d'Anvers
filmography.role_description: A prostitute in Antwerp who hopes to escape her life with a sailor, but her pimp stands in the way.
filmography.plot: A tragic romance in the port of Antwerp involving a prostitute, a kind sailor, and a ruthless pimp.

filmography.title: Macadam
filmography.role_description: A seductive woman running a seedy hotel involved with gangsters. One of her earliest leading roles.
filmography.plot: A noirish tale of crime and passion centered around a rundown hotel in Paris.

filmography.title: Against the Wind
filmography.role_description: A French resistance fighter working with British saboteurs during WWII.
filmography.plot: British agents are parachuted into occupied Belgium to destroy Gestapo records and rescue a key resistance figure.

filmography.title: Rude Journée pour la Reine
filmography.role_description: A working-class mother who retreats into a fantasy world where she imagines herself as royalty or the mother of a famous criminal.
filmography.plot: A woman tired of her mundane life and demanding family daydreams of a more exciting existence.

filmography.title: Adua and Her Friends (Adua e le compagne)
filmography.role_description: A prostitute who tries to open a legitimate restaurant with her friends after brothels are outlawed in Italy.
filmography.plot: After the Merlin Law closes Italian brothels, four prostitutes attempt to start a new life by opening a restaurant, but face prejudice and corruption.

filmography.title: La Chair de l'orchidée
filmography.role_description: An eccentric aristocrat in this adaptation of a James Hadley Chase novel.
filmography.plot: A wealthy heiress escapes from an asylum and finds herself caught between two hitmen and her murderous aunt.

filmography.title: Thérèse Raquin
filmography.role_description: An oppressed wife who plots with her lover to murder her sickly husband.
filmography.plot: An adaptation of Émile Zola's novel updated to 1950s Lyon, focusing on guilt and retribution after a murder.
filmography.awards: Venice Film Festival: Win – Silver Lion (Marcel Carné)

filmography.title: L'Étoile du Nord
filmography.role_description: The owner of an Egyptian boarding house in this adaptation of a Georges Simenon novel. Signoret's final film role.
filmography.plot: A Frenchman returning from Egypt stays at a boarding house and becomes involved in a murder mystery.
